segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Dana,

Recap from this morning: 46 seats, annual term, standard support, target go-live June 17. I attached the implementation outline and the security packet.

If you can send billing contact and PO requirements, I’ll get the order form moving.

Matt

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Thanks Matt.

Billing contact is Priya Shah, ap@northlakebuild.com. PO is required over $25k. Can you make sure the invoice shows the department code 4107 and the service dates? Finance kicked one back last month for missing dates.

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Yep, can do. Invoice will show 6/17/2026 through 6/16/2027 and dept code 4107. I’ll put Priya as billing contact in the CRM and copy you on the order form.

For rollout, we’d do admin setup the week of 6/3, data import by 6/10, and user training on 6/14.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
That timeline works.

One thing: we need the data import capped at 8 hours. Our ops team can clean up the duplicate accounts before handoff, so we should not need more than that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Agreed. I updated the scope to 8 implementation hours for import and 2 live training sessions. Anything beyond that would need written approval from you before we schedule it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Ok.

Per your note Friday, we’ll put $39,840 on the PO. I know the order form I have still shows $42,600, so send the refreshed one when the paperwork catches up.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the final order form today with the service dates, 46 seats, and the 8-hour import cap. Legal’s redlines on limitation of liability were accepted, so no blocker there.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Please include our full legal name: Northlake Building Supply LLC. Address is 1180 Cooper Ave, Suite 300, Columbus, OH 43215.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Got it. I’ll use Northlake Building Supply LLC and that Columbus address.

Once signed, our onboarding coordinator will reach out within one business day to schedule the kickoff.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Thanks. If you get it over before 3 central, I can route it with today’s PO batch.

Dana
